description.value:
Trigger A creature moves within 30 feet of the improperly stored szandite crystals

Effect All creatures within 30 feet of the exposed szandite crystals form a sudden mental link with the Krethiskar Swarm mind. Their vision is momentarily filled with the image of insectile eyes as a malevolent will threatens to overpower them. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save. The hazard then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is stupefied 1 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is stupefied 1 for 1 minute and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 2}.

details.description: Improperly stored szandite crystals form a temporary mental link between the Swarm mind and nearby creatures.
details.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:25] (trained) or @Check[occultism|dc:25] (trained) to sever the connection through the crystals, @Check[crafting|dc:21] or @Check[physical-science-lore|dc:21] to properly seal the crate, @Check[will|dc:28] save to overcome the immense willpower of the Swarm, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Dispel Magic] (3rd rank; counteract DC 21); three total successes are required to disable the hazard

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path

details.routine: (3 actions) The hazard loses 1 action each turn for each success earned to disable it. The Swarm mind uses all of its actions on its turn to fix its mental gaze on a number of targets equal to the number of actions remaining in its routine, boring into their minds. The creatures take @Damage[(2d8+9)[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:24|basic] save).
